Blatter, the president» Sepp Blatter was the president of FIFA for 17 years and is currently serving an 8-year sentence for several corruption scandals that occurred during his administration. Under his mandate, Qatar was chosen to host the 2022 World Cup. Informe+ approaches those who knew him best and those who were closest to him to draw the profile of one of the most controversial figures in the recent history of football.

programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Andoni Zubizarreta» Andoni Zubizarreta developed his professional career at Deportivo Alavés, Athletic Club, FCBarcelona and Valencia. Representative of the great school of Basque goalkeepers, he is the footballer with the most games played in the history of the First Division. He played 622 games and all of them as a starter between 1981 and 1988. He was part of the golden era of Johan Cruyff's so-called Dream Team, winning the first European Cup in the history of the Catalan club. In 1994 and with his sixth league championship title, he left the Barcelona team to play for Valencia CF. Natural, sober, respectful and professional leader, Andoni Zubizarreta has been one of the best goalkeepers in the Spanish championship and is also still first in the classification of minutes played

programme.desc: «Football according to Raúl (1): Almost Champions» It is often said that we only remember the champion, that no one remembers the runner-up. But there are teams that, due to their trajectory and their way of falling, have gone down in history despite not lifting the trophy. This is the case of Espanyol in the 1988 UEFA, which lost on penalties against Bayer Leverkusen, and of Alavés in the 2001 UEFA, which was defeated 5-4 by Liverpool with a golden goal in its own goal. Raúl tells us the story of those two modest teams that, against all odds, reached their first European final, eliminating the greats of Europe. Two unforgettable deeds etched in the hearts of their fans

programme.title: Football according to Raúl (T1): Almost Champions
programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Messi» Lionel Andrés Messi Cuccittini, known as Leo Messi, is currently considered the best player in the world and one of the best of all time. He is the first footballer in history to have won, among other distinctions, the Ballon d'Or five times, the first four consecutively and five Golden Boots. Since he arrived at the age of 13 at the F.C. Barcelona has not stopped progressing and exhibiting its talent day after day in the Championship, shattering all the records that cross its path. Leo Messi is a living and active legend who, at only 31 years old, is already the all-time top scorer in LaLiga, surpassing myths like Cristiano Ronaldo, Telmo Zarra, Hugo Sánchez or Raúl González Blanco

programme.title: 90 years of stories (T2019): Messi
programme.desc: «The Others (2): Uruguayans» With three and a half million inhabitants, no other country has so many international titles. Uruguay is not only the smallest country to win a World Cup (twice). What does Uruguay have that makes it different from all other countries in the world? "Uruguayans" reviews the best stories of Uruguayan football with valuable testimonies from footballers, politicians and other figures in public life. Where football is the basis of national culture, the stories intertwine in a documentary full of passion, tragedy, glory and football.

programme.title: d/s Megacities. Mexico City
programme.desc: Mexico City is the largest city in the world, spread over an area of ​​1,400 square kilometers. However, for its 18 million inhabitants it is not just another metropolis. Mexico City is a city where the main rule of the real estate market is not observed - the guaranteed location of the property. On the one hand, Mexico City is one of the most seismically active places in the world, on the other hand, one of the most active volcanoes in the world is located nearby. And right under the feet of the residents of the metropolis there is a shaky foundation made of garbage and household waste. To Mother Nature, Mexico City is one big target that could be hit by an earthquake at any moment. But the city opposes the destructive forces of nature with the power of science. The most modern technologies aimed at ensuring the safety of residents were used in the construction of the metro and expressways in Mexico City. Rising above the city, the tallest skyscraper in Latin America was built using giant absorbers that can absorb seismic vibrations. Since for residents it is not a question of whether or not there will be an earthquake, but when it will happen, the city is also equipped with a flexible earthquake protection system, which is a ground vibration detection system that can alert residents of an impending eruption within one minute. Cast: Jackie Chan. UK, USA, 2006

programme.title: d/s Megapolisy. Sao Paulo
programme.desc: It is the second largest city on earth and the most important city in Brazil. More than 10 million inhabitants live in Sao Paolo, but the problem of supplying residents with food is not the problem here - the problem is garbage collection. Every day, San Paolo removes 14,000 tons of garbage - the weight of the famous Leaning Tower of Pisa. Sao Paolo has committed itself to the green revolution, converting hectares of waste into energy production. Aluminum cans are the most recyclable item on earth, and Brazil is a leader in this form of recycling because it not only recycles cans, but does so at an incredible rate. This film follows the journey of an aluminum can from the moment it is picked up by one of those who make a living collecting trash for recycling, to the assembly line where it is flattened, melted and re-melted, to the moment it is turned into raw material for the manufacture of a new can. The latest technology, combined with pure Brazilian ingenuity, not only contributes to the creation of an environmentally friendly environment, but also helps the city's poor residents earn a living. Starring: Paterson Joseph, Claudia Sheinbaum, Jacobo Zabludovsky, Tk Singh, Juan Manuel Espinoza, Pedro Ferríz de Con, Arturo Aispuro, Jackie Chan. UK, USA, 2006

programme.title: d/s Megacities. Las Vegas
programme.desc: When you think about where to play, you immediately think of Las Vegas, this man-made oasis created by people in the middle of the desert. However, the main secret of Las Vegas is not the game itself, not the connections, or even the sex. The basis of this metropolis is electricity. Without electricity, Las Vegas will simply die. In this series you will see Las Vegas as no one has ever seen it before. Power lines are his arteries, and electricity is his blood. We will look behind the outer cover of this metropolis, get acquainted with its vital organs and descend lower than anyone else - into the very heart of the metropolis. In a city built in a rather risky place to live, energy is a window into the soul of the city, because making the pulse of this city beat is the biggest game of all. Cast: Jackie Chan. UK, USA, 2006

programme.title: d/s Megacities. New York

programme.title: d/f Big cats of the Serengeti
programme.desc: The Serengeti is a region in East Africa that is home to about seventy species of large mammals. The documentary will introduce channel viewers to some of the most notable and interesting inhabitants of these places: lions and cheetahs. The plot centers on several families, each of them daily fighting a difficult struggle for survival in the savannah. Here are just a few real-life wildlife stories that would be the envy of any film writer. Two lion cubs, born during the dry season, find themselves on the brink of starvation because their mother Kali runs out of milk. Desperate to feed her cubs, she finds and eats the carcass of a dead hippopotamus... A lonely male cheetah, Moto, falls in love with Nyota. At first they become friends, and soon start a family. But one day Nyota disappears, and Moto goes in search of her across the endless African plains. Dir.: Jongyul Lee. South Korea, 2019

programme.desc: Wombat mũi có lông, linh dương Kakapo và Sài Gòn có điểm gì chung? Tất cả chúng đều nằm trong số những con vật hiếm nhất trên trái đất. Audrey, 7 tuổi, chia sẻ cuộc sống hàng ngày của cô với họ tại một nơi trú ẩn động vật hoang dã làm việc để bảo vệ các loài bị đe dọa tuyệt chủng.

programme.title: NHƯ NHỮNG CÁI ĐẦU KHÔNG CÓ HEN - COMME DES TÊTES PAS DE POULE
programme.desc: Máu mát cho trái tim ấm áp Hàng xóm bị cắt điện, ngoại trừ nhà Babin-Bibeau. Pierre-Charles ẩn náu ở đó cùng mẹ và người chăm sóc. Sigis, người đảm bảo an ninh cho trường học trong thời gian cắt điện, tiếp đón Rosalie, người muốn qua đêm ở đó. programme.title: TAMIA
programme.desc: Tamia là một cô gái trẻ can đảm không làm gì mà không cần suy nghĩ cẩn thận. Cô ấy muốn trở thành một người hòa giải giữa cha mẹ và con cái của họ, một tiếng nói cho những người không có ai. Được bạn bè Audrey, Sara, Yao và Cheick giúp đỡ, cô thích nhiều cuộc phiêu lưu, đưa khán giả trẻ của mình vào một hành trình thực sự.

programme.title: HUYNH ĐỆ KỲ TÍCH - MIRACULOUS BROTHERS, TẬP 15
programme.desc: Yook Dong Ju (Jung Woo) có niềm đam mê lẫn tài năng viết lách, nhưng suốt 7 năm sau khi tốt nghiệp, anh vẫn chưa có lấy một tác phẩm được xuất bản, đã vậy còn ngập trong nợ nần và phải gánh theo một bà mẹ hay gây chuyện khắp nơi. Một ngày nọ, anh vô tình gặp Kang San (Bae Hyun Sung) và trở thành người giám hộ của cậu. Kang San từng gặp tai nạn dẫn đến mất trí nhớ, không còn ký ức gì về quá khứ lẫn tên tuổi của bản thân, nhưng cậu lại có khả năng đọc suy nghĩ và cảm nhận được nỗi đau, sự tuyệt vọng của người khác. Vì lẽ đó, Kang San không bao giờ ngần ngại lên tiếng vì công bằng và chính nghĩa. Vì năng lực đặc biệt của San mà Dong Ju cũng bắt đầu kết nối với nhiều mảnh đời khổ sở hơn. Dong Ju và San - hai con người khác biệt về nhiều thứ nhanh chóng trở thành những người anh em, và cùng nhau tạo nên điều kỳ diệu.

Rang dạy Kang-jin những bài học đầu tiên về nghề cho vay siêu lợi nhuận, từ đó biến cậu học trò lầm lì trở thành chiến thần tài chính, đại gia mới nổi, ông hoàng cho vay nặng lãi của trường trung học Geumhwa.

programme.desc: Trong thành Trường An, những vụ án về tân nương mất tích liên tiếp xảy ra, dường như có liên quan tới món hồng trà nổi tiếng. Án kiện khó bề phân giải, lòng người thâm sâu khó đoán. programme.title: GẤU MÈO TAFFY
programme.desc: Dưới sự chăm sóc tỉ mỉ của Quý bà giàu có Muchmore, chú chó Bentley được sống trong một tòa lâu đài sang trọng và hưởng cuộc sống trong nhung lụa. Trong khi đó, chú gấu mèo Scraggs mỗi ngày phải bới rác và nhặt thức ăn thừa để sống. Ước ao có cuộc sống như Bentley, Scraggs thử hết cách này đến cách khác nhưng không thành, cho tới khi chú cũng đeo một chiếc nơ đỏ như Bentley. May mắn đã mỉm cười với Scraggs, quý bà giàu có Muchmore đã nhận nuôi chú gấu mèo và đặt tên nó là Taffy. Vậy là những tì
